items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Jeremy Schon & Greg Ormont interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: I still can’t shred like Steve Vai unfortunately

ctx.x: That’s terrific. Jeremy do you have any AHA moments that you can remember? © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

I mean I remember what kind of sparked me to really play guitar you know. Like my parents are both musicians and like they always, from a young age they tried to get me to play different instruments but I don’t know, I was not the kind of kid who was going to — I wanted to be on my own path. And so I did pretty poorly at like piano at age six. I even tried guitar around that same time and didn’t take to it unfortunately. I wish I did, I would be that much better. But when I was twelve my dad had this band. He’s a…
Yeah something between you and the people looking at you. You’ve got a buffer of a sort.
